summary.text: Brian Miller is the Democratic nominee for Montana's 2nd Congressional District. A Helena attorney originally from Florida who has lived in Montana since the late 1990s, he handles civil cases for small businesses, consumers and individuals. He won the June 2 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Is originally from Florida and has lived in Montana since the late 1990s.

Has practiced law in Helena since at least 2010 with the firm Morrison, Sherwood, Wilson and Deola, and runs a private practice handling civil cases for small businesses, consumers and other individuals against insurance companies, banks and others.
Has two children, whom he told the Glendive Ranger-Review are his greatest motivation for running.
Launched his campaign in late 2025 and won the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary, defeating Sam Lux and state Sen. Jonathan Windy Boy, who had suspended his campaign.
